findings.text: the probe's docstring claims the launch is assembled "exactly as reckon.crew.dispatch does at the point it spawns a cli backend" but dispatch first applies resolve_launch_executable (dispatch.py:3925) before apply_backend_placement (3940), so the printed argv's argv[0] is the bare clive where a real spawn carries the absolute resolve_launch_executable result; the placement prefix is unaffected so the reviewed claim holds, but the receipt overstates its fidelity to the spawn argv.

the negative-control note's restoration hash is quoted as a 65-character token (c2a13835be8f586417a896b3b59d6209919bafce2d86daf2062bfa8bac11f4958) that matches no revision of flight.yaml at either 58ea2f84 or 9c6409ba: the true value at 58ea2f84 is the 64-character c2a13835be8f586417a896b3b59d6209919bafce2d86daf2062fe8bac11f4958, which I re-derived, so the underlying restoration claim is true and corroborated, but a receipt whose hash does not resolve cannot be checked against the artifact by anyone else - exactly the class that fails silently.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 7419c8c2e6c5369adcc25eae419d76d7bb2f4768 - 58ea2f84 lands the declaration and the figure, fc71f239 appends the evidence anchor and the plan comment as pure insertions (+95 and +7, zero deletions, so the cumulative records are spliced rather than rewritten), and 9c6409ba adds the final newline with content unchanged.
item_verdicts.done_when: the six measures are recorded in gate1/gate2/gate3/gate5/gate6 logs, all EXIT=0, with squeue before and after adding no allocation; measure (3) as worded is unsatisfiable and the worker names that in follow_ons - the dry-run payload carries no argv at all (the pre-launch record writes argv: None at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3888 and the recorded payload has no argv key) - and the substituted instrument, the live launch path, reproduces the placed argv in my own independent run.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to declare clive worker placement in the imas-ambix flight layer so dispatch places workers into the already-held rigel allocation through reckon's project-scoped record; docs/state/imas-ambix/flight.yaml:47-51 lands that declaration (scheduler srun, the two queries with {job}), and my own call of reckon's launch path against the reviewed tree resolved a clive launch to /usr/bin/srun --overlap --jobid=1276262.
item_verdicts.manifest: audited field by field against the gate logs: gates, logs, artifacts and both plan constraints (record read and never written, no allocation submitted) match what the logs show, and the restoration is corroborated independently - sha256 of flight.yaml at 58ea2f84 is c2a13835be8f586417a896b3b59d6209919bafce2d86daf2062fe8bac11f4958, the pre-mutation content, and the current tree differs from it only by the final-newline commit 9c6409ba - but the note's quoted value is a 65-character token that matches no revision of the file, so the quote as written cannot be checked against the artifact even though the claim underneath it holds; that malformity is this record's second finding.
item_verdicts.write_paths: across the three commits the diff touches docs/state/imas-ambix/flight.yaml, docs/figures/slurm-hosted-agent-fleet/placement-project-record.svg, docs/evidence/archive/slurm-hosted-agent-fleet-landed.html and docs/plans/slurm-hosted-agent-fleet.html - exactly the four declared paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declaration carries no committed test of its own - the machinery it feeds is covered by reckon tests/test_crew_placement.py, but nothing under tests/ reads the flight layer, so deleting the block or misspelling the query reddens nothing and the gate's mutation re-run (negative-control.log) is the closest guard and is not committed.
justifications.evidence: (a) the run-liveness path consumes the declared query at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4194 through runs.py:scheduler_job_reason, which substitutes {job} to 1276262 (runs.py:2647 and 2650) and forwards %r verbatim - squeue's reason field, answering None on the live job where the reservation default %R answers 98dci4-clu-2002 - so the spelling is what the path substitutes rather than a table-keyed alternative; (b) the gate3 argv is reckon's own rather than the probe script's: my independent run of _backends.launch_plan plus crew.dispatch.apply_backend_placement at 9c6409ba reproduces /usr/bin/srun --overlap --jobid=1276262 byte-for-byte, --jobid appears nowhere in the probe script, and the token originates in reckon/crew/placement.py:step_prefix fed by read_reservation('imas-ambix')['job_id']; withheld 3 for two receipt defects whose underlying facts I nonetheless corroborated independently - the probe docstring's spawn-argv fidelity claim and the manifest's malformed restoration-hash quote - both carried as findings.
justifications.fit: flight.yaml:12-46 keeps the file's own comment voice and states the arming and its reason in mechanism terms, the declaration sits under backends.clive with the project layer's version: 1 shape, the anchor references the figure project-absolutely, and no filename, symbol or comment carries a plan, sprint or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/state/imas-ambix/flight.yaml:47-51 declares exactly the placement the goal names and my own launch_plan plus apply_backend_placement call against the reviewed tree resolves to srun --overlap --jobid=1276262, withheld from 20 only because until it is merged real dispatches resolve unarmed, as my own live pointer shows with job_id null and placement null.
justifications.scope_discipline: every hunk across 58ea2f84, fc71f239 and 9c6409ba lies inside the four declared write paths, the evidence and plan edits are insertions only with zero deletions from the cumulative records, and the plan-version and plan-modified meta lines are untouched.
